NHS ENGLAND: A&E FOUR HOUR PERFORMANCEENGLAND.NHS.UK ↗

Use it: three in four patients are getting through A&E inside four hours, and the figure has slipped against both the previous month and the same month last year. If what you sell shortens time in the department, avoids an admission or frees a bed earlier, that is the number the urgent and emergency care lead is measured on. Ask which of their sites sits furthest below the national figure.

Source: NHS England, A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions, June 2026, published 9 July 2026. NHS England publishes this on the second Thursday of each month, covering the previous month. This figure is entered by hand and does not update itself.
